items.recommendation: Open GSC (search.google.com/search-console), paste this URL in the URL Inspection bar, and click 'Request Indexing'. Coverage state 'Discovered - currently not indexed' means Google found the URL (likely via sitemap or internal links) but has queued it without crawling for 37 days. Verify the page returns 200, has no noindex meta tag, and that the canonical self-references the correct URL. If indexing is still not triggered after 2 weeks, check whether Googlebot is being rate-limited across the blog.

Open GSC, paste this URL in the URL Inspection bar, and click 'Request Indexing'. Coverage state 'URL is unknown to Google' means no Googlebot visit has occurred - expected for a post published today. Verify the post appears in the XML sitemap (run npm run build in the web repo and check dist/sitemap*.xml), that the canonical tag points to https://franlledo.com/blog/claude-code-sin-programar/, and that there is no noindex meta tag. IndexNow ping (via the automatic post-publish step) should also accelerate Bing/ChatGPT Search discovery.
